title: NATS KV values: bucket registry (keys <host>.<env>.nodes|workflows|models|loras|looks) and bucket hosts (key <host>.<env>)
description: Each runner writes only its own keys: the five registry keys once at start, its hosts key every 10 s (studio treats a hosts key older than 30 s as offline). studio_service reads them. Every value carries schema_version (major, versioned like a message).

portType.description: a port's value type; an input accepts an output of the same type, and an input of type Media also accepts Image and Video (contracts/README.md, Graph rules: fits). Text, Image, Video (an MP4, may carry audio), Int, Float, Seed, Canvas, Duration ({frames, fps}) are plain values; Media is an input type only (the output node's `media`), never an output or a param; Model, Conditioning, Latent are family-scoped handles: they only wire nodes of one family inside one workflow and never cross a process (Latent[ltx] carries the video and audio latents together)

optional.description: inputs only: true = may be left unwired (the feature is off; the stage gets no such key); absent = false, a required input

paramSchema.description: one param of a node; the UI derives a form field from it. int, float and seed: min/max bound the value, step is the field's increment; string and text (multi-line): min/max bound the length; enum: one of `enum`. seed: an int where null or -1 means random (the runner picks one and reports it in evt.run.status resolved.seed and each output's seed). image: one Image, written {take_id} by clients (default null = none; a run needs one). rows: an ordered list of items (default []), min/max bound the count, `item` names each item's fields, `mention` is how the prompt refers to item n (from 1). frames: a frame count on the family's frame grid, min + k × step (k ≥ 0) up to max (LTX: 9 + 8k, 9..321); `fps` names the node's fps param; the UI renders it as the Duration slider (one notch per step, labelled frames and seconds). frames may declare `auto` (the model predicts the length: the value "auto"). int may declare `values` (the only allowed values) and `values_by` (the allowed values per value of an enum param of the same node: LTX steps per role)

name.description: unique among the kind's params and inputs; `bypass` is reserved (the Studio path <node>.bypass)

fps.description: frames only: the name of the same node's int or float param that holds frames per second; the UI shows the length as frames / fps seconds

auto.description: frames only: present = the model can predict the clip's length from the prompt; the value "auto" asks for it. The prediction is clamped to min_s..max_s seconds and to the param's min..max frames, then put on the grid (contracts/README.md, Video: auto length). The UI draws the Duration slider's Auto length switch from it

label.description: the field label; absent = the name

step.description: int, float, seed: the field's increment (int: an integer)

values.description: int only: the only allowed values, ascending, each within min..max, the default among them; the UI draws a choice (one allowed value: a read-only readout), studio refuses others (`<node>.<param>: must be one of <values>`)

values_by.description: int with `values` only: the allowed values depend on the node's value of enum param `param`: values[that value] (a subset of `values`; an enum value not listed allows all of `values`). The message names that subset (LTX sample: role stage1 -> [8], stage2 -> [3])

when.description: visibility expression over the graph, e.g. "model.variant != 'turbo'" (<node id>.<param>); absent = always shown. Carried through as is; studio evaluates it in a later stage, the runner ignores it

item.description: rows only: field name → a ref kind (the field holds a value of that kind, required in every item: Image = a take {take_id}; Lora = a LoRA {lora_id}, contracts/README.md, LoRAs) or a param schema (without name; not rows)

mention.description: rows only: the text by which a prompt refers to item n (from 1), e.g. <image{n}>; the prompt carries it as is, the pack does not rewrite it

itemParam.description: a rows item field that is a param: a paramSchema without name, not rows or image (an item may add `position`)

label.description: the field label; absent = the name

step.description: int, float, seed: the field's increment (int: an integer)

position.description: float only: the field is a time on the clip in seconds (a keyframe's place): studio turns it into the pixel frame min(round(s * fps), F - 1) of the workflow's frames param and refuses rows past the clip or on a frame another row uses (contracts/README.md, Video: keyframes); the rows editor draws it on the clip's length

family.description: the model family (the kind's prefix); null for a core node

media.description: what its takes are: the Image / Video switch filters templates by it. Absent = image. Must equal what studio computes from the graph (contracts/README.md, Video: a workflow's media)

nodes.description: params here override the node schema's defaults; the run's inputs override both

studio.description: the Studio (Create) layout studio sends as the template's Workflow.studio; absent = the derived form. Its paths obey the graph rules for a user workflow's block (studio_unknown_path, studio_duplicate)

nodes.description: registry key <host>.<env>.nodes: every node kind this runner can execute

workflows.description: registry key <host>.<env>.workflows: the workflows this runner offers; each workflow's env is the key's env and uses only kinds in its .nodes

models.description: registry key <host>.<env>.models: the models present on this host for this env

variants.description: the model's variants on this host (section 9.2 of docs/plan/06-platform.md); absent for a model without variants (echo)

id.description: the value of the family's model node variant param

bytes.description: size on disk of the variant's own files (shared files counted once, in the variant that owns them); absent when missing

precisions.description: what it can load as, first = native. A full-precision variant lists its dtype then the load-time quantizations (bf16, int8; MLX also int4); an already-quantized one lists only its own (int8): no choice, nothing quantized at load

lora.description: present when the family takes LoRAs (it publishes a <family>/lora-stack node)

loras.description: registry key <host>.<env>.loras: the shared LoRAs this runner indexed on its host (every *.safetensors under <models>/loras/ and under any loras/ folder inside a model folder), written at start. Studio's LoRA library lists the union over live hosts; the dispatcher sends a run that names a shared LoRA only to a host whose key lists it

id.description: the file's SHA-256 (the runner hashes it once and keeps the hash by path, size and mtime): the LoRA's id everywhere

name.description: the file name without .safetensors, cut to 80

family.description: the first family of this runner's packs (by name) the normaliser fits it to (every key applied or ignored, at least one applied); unknown when none

licence.description: __metadata__ modelspec.license, else license, trimmed; null when neither

host.description: bucket hosts, key <host>.<env>: the runner's live state, rewritten every 10 s. Never shown to users as is: GET /v1/studio/hosts redacts it.

run_id.description: the run in progress (busy), else null

memory.description: GPU / unified memory the runner may use and uses now

resident.description: model components loaded now (the residency manager's view)

model.description: a model id of the models key

pinned.description: in use by the running run: not evictable

loras.description: a component with LoRAs baked in (mode bake) is its own entry: those LoRAs, in order; absent or empty = the plain component. Adapter LoRAs are not listed. GET /v1/studio/hosts shows another user's own LoRA only as its size

attempt.description: the attempt of run_id in progress (busy); absent when idle. The dispatcher's lease check compares (run_id, attempt)

loraBlock.description: a family's LoRA rules (the `lora:` block of its model.yaml): what the normaliser needs to apply a LoRA file to this family, and what studio needs to detect a file's family (contracts/README.md, LoRA normaliser). The stack node's row cap, strength range and modes are in the <family>/lora-stack node schema

component.description: the weight component LoRAs patch (transformer); a stage whose `uses` holds it sees the Model's LoRA set

modules.description: the component's Linear module names a LoRA may target (canonical, dotted, as the model's named_modules), sorted; one numeric range `{a..b}` per entry expands to a..b inclusive (transformer_blocks.{0..31}.attn.to_q). The runner generates it from the meta-device model; with every `.` read as `_` the expanded names must still be unique (kohya)

renames.description: family-specific key fixes, in order: the first that matches a key's module part (after the style's prefix and suffix are cut) replaces the matched part with `to`. `at: start` (default): `from` starts the part (a prefix rewrite); `at: end`: `from` ends it (LTX: `.to_out.0` -> `.to_out`). Most families: []

at.description: where `from` must match: start (default) or end of the module part

ignore.description: glob patterns (fnmatch: `*` any run, `?` one character; case-sensitive) over raw tensor keys that are counted as ignored instead of unapplied. Empty = every key must apply

prefused.description: LoRAs already fused into a variant's weights (LTX: the distilled LoRA is part of the distilled transformer): a stack row naming one on a model of that variant is 422 at run (`<node>.<param>[<i>].lora: LoRA <name> is already part of the <variant> weights`), so it is never applied twice. The runner fills lora_id from its LoRA index (model.yaml names the file); absent = none

looks.description: registry key <host>.<env>.looks: the starter looks of this runner's packs (runner_service/packs/<pack>/looks/*.yaml, contracts/README.md Looks: starter looks), written at start (an empty list when its packs ship none). Studio lists the union over live hosts to every user, read-only; a look's id is the same on every host
every look of every pack of this env, by pack, then file name, then file order; ids unique

id.description: <family>/<the YAML id>: the look's id everywhere (LibraryItem.id, RunRequest.looks), stable across hosts

family.description: the pack's family (= the id's first part)

text.description: appended to the prompt; may be empty only when the look has a LoRA

version.description: the YAML version (default 1); a pack bumps it when it changes the look, so reuse can say changed

loras.description: the YAML lora, when it has one

file.description: the file name as written in the YAML, looked up in the folders the LoRA index scans (contracts/README.md, LoRAs: shared)

name.description: the file name without .safetensors, cut to 80 (the index's name)

lora_id.description: the file's SHA-256 = its shared LoRA id in <host>.<env>.loras; null when this host has no such file (studio then takes another live host's)

key.description: packs/<family>/looks/<id>-<first 16 hex of the file's SHA-256>.<ext>: the YAML image, which the runner PUTs to the object store at start unless that key exists (content-addressed, never overwritten). Shown only as the look's thumb_url; never a reference image

studioLayout.description: openapi.yaml StudioLayout (check.py keeps the two equal): which params Create shows and where. Absent = the derived form
